populationDefinition: Successful matched code/map pairs, three repetitions each; one real trace selected at the median whole-compile wall time for each source/strategy/mode. Failed compiles and incomplete cells are separate.
percentileDefinition: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p (R7); tail averages take ceil(0.1*n) items; lower=fast, upper=slow; absent pass costs are zero in all_* and omitted in active_*.
timingUnit: milliseconds unless column explicitly says otherwise
passTimeDefinition: Attributed: exclusive time plus nested shared component work owned by nearest active pass; excludes separately attributed nested different passes. Inclusive includes them; do not sum inclusive columns.
